analysis_status: Post-hoc contextual transfer of a fixed descriptive list, not preregistration, untouched validation or a primary replication vote.
fixed_primary_gene_family: All 9675 count-common genes; retain the complete 105 descriptive candidates and 36 baseline-plus-LOO priorities without choosing external matches.

contrasts.role: Early whole-testis perturbation; source control genotype retained as control
Heterozygote-control early-development context; not WT and not an independent vote from P7
Heterozygote-control early-development context; not WT and not an independent vote from P2
Reported phenotype-negative comparator, not known zero transcriptomic effect or an arrest case
Germ-cell-targeted early context; cKO minus flox/- noCre, batch-adjusted
Somatic-cell-targeted early context; cKO minus flox/flox noCre; same gene as P1, not a separate genetic model

mapping: Exact symbols. For Lrh1 exclude every duplicated nonempty symbol among tested Ensembl genes; no largest-effect selection or identifier guessing. Repeat this rule separately in every cached LOO variant.
effects: Use frozen previously fitted KO-minus-source-control logFC and cached leave-one-out effects. This branch does not re-fit these external cohorts, rebuild annotations or repeat their raw preprocessing.
summaries: Coverage, matching nonzero sign and at least log2(1.5) in the fixed candidate direction, with complete availability required before all-LOO retention. Missing is never zero. Report every contrast with explicit denominators, without enrichment P-values or independence assumptions over genes.
limitations: Sources and prior effect correlations were seen in earlier exploratory work; not an untouched holdout.
Early P1-P9 tissues cannot be treated as equivalent to later meiotic-arrest tissues.
Two Pramef12 ages and two Lrh1 Cre experiments are not four independent genetic models.
No inference that failure to transfer disproves shared biology, that a sign match proves a mechanism, or that Msl3 supplies a known statistical null.
